name: MiniMax H3 · references

video_from_references.note: Reference-to-video: the images and the video are material (character, style, motion), not frames of the result. With neither it is text-to-video. The prompt names them <Picture N> and <Video 1>.

description: MiniMax H3 from reference images (characters, style) and a reference video, with sound. Runs on your GPU; nothing leaves this machine.

references.note: Every reference image, one loader. Order matters: image N is <Picture N>.

detachWhenAbsent.note: No reference video: LoadVideo is unplugged, so it never runs.

referenceVideo.note: <Video 1>, with its own soundtrack when it has one.

frames.note: 17k+5 frames at 24 fps, as every H3 template.

prompt.note: No preamble: the user's own words are the prompt, as in the official ComfyUI template. The images are read by the node, not described in text.

$IMAGE_PATHS.note: reference images, one filename per line

$FRAMES.note: output length; the bridge rounds up to 17k+5

$CHECKPOINT.note: chosen from requires.checkpoints, never by the caller

models.note: nvfp4 has no native kernels on Ampere, so on a 3090 it is emulated -- the same situation as Qwen 2511's fp8mixed, which measured 8.6x slower. It runs once per prompt, not per step, but measure it before believing it is fine.

compatibility.note: Pruned ref2va with the Turbo LoRA (v0.1) at 4 steps. Not measured on the 3090 yet.

nodePacks.name: comfyui-reanimator
nodePacks.note: Loads a run-time list of references and calls ComfyUI's MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo once.

notes: Built by tools/build_h3_keyframes_template.py from minimax-h3-flf; edit that script, not this file.
